description:
Play SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance's SEGA Villains Stage DLC now on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/shinobi-art-of-vengeance-sega-villains-stage-70050000055174-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01 

Joe Musashi battles classic SEGA Villains: Majima, the mad dog of Shimano from the Yakuza/Like a Dragon series, Dr. Eggman, the evil genius from the Sonic the Hedgehog series, and Death Adder, the ruthless giant from Golden Axe!

This new villainous DLC includes: 
- 5 stages 
- 3 bosses (Majima, Dr. Eggman, and Death Adder) 
- 3 ninpos 
- 3 skins 
- 6 music tracks inspired by each SEGA Villain IP 
- 2 Boss Rush Modes featuring the new bosses 

Wield the katana and obliterate all who stand in your way!

author: Nintendo of America
description:
The #TomodachiLife: Living the Dream game launches on the Nintendo Switch system April 16, 2026. Pre-orders and a demo are available now on Nintendo eShop: https://ninten.do/6007QxbdP

Back at it again on Yoomian Island! But what is Crystal up to these days? She’s earning her keep, checking out the latest fashions, and being an all-around bestest best friend to Angie!

Become the caretaker of an island full of silliness, drama, love, and other surprises in Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream.

This game is also compatible with the Nintendo Switch 2 system.
